t: You are looking at the Ventilation Shaft Cover, a sculpture by Eduardo Paolozzi. A cover for a ventilation shaft is an everyday piece of city equipment, and here it has been turned into a work of art. Paolozzi was a Scottish artist, known for his sculpture and his graphic work. He is widely considered one of the pioneers of pop art. So it is worth a closer look, because a plain functional object has been given the attention of one of Britain's best-known modern artists.
